Hi Sara — thanks for the screenshot and the form, that helps.

Short answer: we usually send a one-time activation code embedded in the claim link, but we've seen cases where the Ariba tenant alias is different between the invitation and the buyer tenant (rare, but causes the code prompt).

Can you confirm two quick things so I can escalate to Ariba if needed: 
1) The exact URL you get after clicking "Claim Account" (paste the full URL)
2) The activation code shown on the Ariba page (if present) and a timestamp of the attempt

What I'll do next: 
- I'll check the invite we generated from our side and confirm the tenant alias.
- If there's a mismatch I'll open a support case with Ariba and request code resync.
- If we need to reissue, we can also send a manual email with a one-time code (short-term workaround).

I've attached our standard vendor onboarding checklist below for your review and noted the fields that tend to block account creation. If possible, please return the completed form to me so we can get your account fully provisioned.

Vendor onboarding checklist: 
- Company legal name, tax ID, remit address
- Primary AP contact + email/phone
- W-9 or equivalent tax form
- Banking details for EFT (or confirmation that PO-only process is acceptable)
- Preferred PO acknowledgement method
